no_rooms: No rooms yet. Add one to get started.
live_hint: Every change is applied to the real lights. Click one to open its controls.
review_hint: Nothing is touched. Switch to live mode to set the lights and see it.
light_treatment: Each light can take the scene, be switched off, or be left alone.
cycle_hint: Each press moves one place down, then wraps.
all_scenes_used: Every scene in this room is already in the list.
import_hint: Home Assistant's own scenes. A scene covering several rooms becomes one scene in each, holding only that room's lights.
nothing_to_import: No Home Assistant scenes to import.
skipped_note: Not imported, because they are in no room of yours:
update_available: A new version of this page is available.
waiting_for_events: Nothing yet. Press a switch, or let a mode change.
curve_hint: What the sun implies for this room across today. The line is brightness; the band behind it is colour temperature.
sending_now: What each light would be sent now
pick_a_room: Pick a room to see its curve.
no_modes: No modes yet. Add one to put the whole house into a film, a night out or a party.
seen_hint: What each switch has published, and what it was read as. A value read as nothing is one this switch has no word for: add it to the matching list of values, or have the switch treat any change as a press.
no_rules: No rules yet. A rule says what one room does in one of this mode's states.
no_scenes: No scenes yet. A scene is this room's lights, set the way you want them.
discard_changes: There are unsaved changes on this screen. Leave without saving?
save_as_preset: Keep this colour under a name
preset_name: What should this colour be called?
no_colour_to_keep: This light has no colour of its own in this scene.
adaptive_scene_hint: The room's own default. Every light in it, following the sun, unless you say otherwise.
about_blurb: One integration for adaptive lighting, scenes, switches and house-wide modes.
discard_changes_hint: What was changed on this screen will be lost.
